_readme: The Theory page (sections/study.html; once called Study materials). 'featured.items' is the list of posters, each only a title and its button word ('open'); each one's 'route' is the page it opens (the laser poster: the laser book, laser-study).

lead.hy: Ֆիզիկան՝ գլուխներով, ինչպես գրքում․ սկզբում պարզ, հետո՝ խորությամբ։
lead.en: Physics in chapters, as in a book: simple first, then in depth.
